title: Area formula for the graph of a C^1 map (import-free)
statement:
Let n, l be natural numbers, D an open subset of R^n and u : R^n -> R^l of class C^1 on D. For a linear P let J(P) := sqrt(det(I_n + (

)_{a,b})) (e_a = EuclideanSpace.single a 1) and let G(x) := graphPoint x (u x) = (x, u(x)). Then for every measurable A contained in D, H^n(G(A)) = integral over A of J(Du(x)) dx in [0, infinity] (lower Lebesgue integral of ENNReal.ofReal (J (fderiv u x)) with respect to Lebesgue measure), where H^n = muHE[n] on R^(n+l).
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (D : Set (Rn n)) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ), IsOpen D → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u D → ∀ A : Set (Rn n), MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ D → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) ((fun x => graphPoint x (u x)) '' A) = ∫⁻ x in A, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ u x (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ u x (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ))))))
